title: Albertson’s conjecture
statement: Albertson’s conjecture · 2007. Every graph with chromatic number r has crossing number at least that of K_r.

counterexample.description: A refutation supplies a drawing below the K_r crossing benchmark, an r-coloring, and a DRAT proof that no (r−1)-coloring exists. Exact crossing counts and the SAT proof make it checkable.
